name: dashboard-page
title: Dashboard page
description: A product dashboard: a side rail, the title and one White button, four figures on cards and the latest rows in a hairline table.
use_for: The overview screen of the product; data comes through `content`.
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a view
Real people or customers in the copy: Acme only
source: Built from the library and the site's surfaces (cards on --surface, the rail on --raised, hairlines, the 36px links of the header)
body: `sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`head`, `stats`, `table`); a key left out is not shown.

files.content:
// The dashboard's sample data for Acme: the nav, four figures and the latest rows. Both flavors read this file; an app
// passes its own through `content`.
export const dashboardContent = {
	nav: [
		{ label: 'Overview', href: '#overview', current: true },
		{ label: 'Search', href: '#search' },
		{ label: 'Boards', href: '#boards' },
		{ label: 'Alerts', href: '#alerts' },
		{ label: 'Settings', href: '#settings' },
	],
	title: 'Overview',
	action: { label: 'New search', href: '#search' },
	stats: [
		{ label: 'Searches this month', value: '1,284' },
		{ label: 'Credits left', value: '3,716' },
		{ label: 'Brands tracked', value: '42' },
		{ label: 'Alerts sent', value: '96' },
	],
	tableTitle: 'Recent searches',
	columns: ['Search', 'Results', 'When'],
	rows: [
		['Running shoes, longest-running ads', '128', 'Today'],
		['Skincare UGC, before and after', '64', 'Yesterday'],
		['Energy drinks on TikTok', '212', 'Monday'],
	],
}
export type DashboardContent = typeof dashboardContent

/** The dashboard's sections in order; pass `sections` to reorder them or leave some out. */
export const dashboardSections = ['head', 'stats', 'table'] as const
export type DashboardSection = (typeof dashboardSections)[number]
